name: Deryan’s Helpful Homunculi

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/magic-of-faerun.  Reference entry; bespoke effects require manual resolution. Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

components.m: gemstone powder worth 100 GP, consumed, and Artisan’s Tools you are proficient with

summary: Reference-only: Intangible, invulnerable helpers are proficient in Arcana and the Artisan’s Tools supplied to cast the spell. They count as one crafting assistant, halving crafting time.
